parameters.command:
=VIDEO_FILE=$(ls /videos/{{ $json.run_id }}_{{ $json.current_video.id }}.* 2>/dev/null | head -1)
if [ -z "$VIDEO_FILE" ]; then
  echo '{"error": "video_not_found"}'
  exit 1
fi
video-analyzer "$VIDEO_FILE" \
  --client openai_api \
  --api-key {{ $env.CLIPROXY_KEY || 'local-proxy-key' }} \
  --api-url {{ $env.CLIPROXY_URL || 'http://cliproxy:8317/v1' }} \
  --model gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite \
  --whisper-model base \
  --output /output/{{ $json.run_id }}_{{ $json.current_video.id }}_analysis.json \
  --max-frames 30 2>&1
cat /output/{{ $json.run_id }}_{{ $json.current_video.id }}_analysis.json 2>/dev/null || echo '{"description": "Analysis failed"}'
